name: openclaw-plugin-kai-youtube-operator
description: OpenClaw plugin for safe YouTube Studio, channel-manager, live-stream, and short-video editing workflows for Kai.

scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run quality && npm test && npm run build && npm run plugin:validate && npm run security:prod
scripts.plugin:build: npm run build && openclaw plugins build --root . --entry ./dist/index.js
scripts.plugin:validate: npm run build && openclaw plugins validate --root . --entry ./dist/index.js
